name: Homework Checker
description: Reports what a student has failed to hand in and how their grades stand, arriving each weekday once school is out. When a Classroom score drops it will also produce a standalone explainer on the topic concerned, so it suits parents tracking one pupil rather than teaching them.

official.title: Homework Checker by Kevin
official.description: Weekday after-school recap of a student's missing work and grades, plus one-time topic summaries when Classroom scores dip.
